policy: Tests 'pinned'/« figé » de la lane D : ils PASSENT en encodant un état non corrigé. Jamais désactivés. Le jour où l'état change, re-baseliner l'assertion dans le même commit que le correctif et déplacer l'entrée ici vers 'closed'. Aucun skip/todo/expected toléré.

pinned.test: MAX_ENTRY_AGE_MS is not a read bound: an entry with a 48 h TTL is still a HIT at 25 h old
pinned.reason: le garde d'âge n'est consulté qu'au sweep d'éviction, jamais en lecture
pinned.action: si le garde devient une borne de lecture, re-baseliner (le HIT à 25 h devient un MISS)

pinned.test: an unknown layout keeps the restaurant with empty sections
pinned.reason: une mise en page inconnue et un menu vide sont indistinguables
pinned.action: distinguer les deux, puis re-baseliner

pinned.test: a repeated section label yields two sections with the same title instead of merging them
pinned.reason: les sections homonymes ne sont pas fusionnées
pinned.action: fusionner, puis re-baseliner

pinned.test: a line 38 high or taller is dropped as a page header, taking a tall menu line with it
pinned.reason: le seuil h ≥ 38 écarte aussi une ligne de menu réelle
pinned.action: affiner le seuil, puis re-baseliner

pinned.test: validation 400 body: English, but DOES NOT MATCH the declared { success, error } schema
pinned.reason: le corps d'erreur du framework n'a pas la forme { success, error } ; le schéma 400 déclare désormais statusCode/code/message (renommé : les messages rendus sont passés de français à anglais)
pinned.action: si le schéma 400 redevient strict, re-baseliner

pinned.test: parseGrades accepts the same truncated table when another paginator key sits between rows and rowCount
pinned.reason: the truncation guard reads the paginator with a strict rows-then-rowCount regex (page-parser.ts assertComplete) and falls back to 0, so a truncated grades or absences page is consumed as complete
pinned.action: make assertComplete read the paginator like parseDataTableWidget, then re-baseline: the page must be refused as truncated

pinned.test: parseChoiceRows accepts a blank group code: the shape check allows an empty column
pinned.reason: CODE_SHAPE and TYPE_SHAPE match the empty string, so a shifted or blank column is accepted and a group can be indexed under an empty code
pinned.action: require a non-empty code, then re-baseline: the row must be refused

pinned.test: listJobs answers an empty array when the page carries no job marker at all
pinned.reason: a login wall or a layout change is indistinguishable from an empty print queue
pinned.action: require a job-list sentinel, then re-baseline: a page without it must raise a named error

pinned.test: a dated page without any restaurant header answers a menu with the date and no restaurant
pinned.reason: parseMenuPdf only refuses when both the date and the restaurants are missing; a menu with an empty date is never considered fresh, so every read downloads and parses the PDF again
pinned.action: refuse a menu without restaurants or without a date, then re-baseline

pinned.test: people: a hyphenated roster class can never match a label token, so collesGroup stays null
pinned.reason: colles.ts compares the raw lowercase roster class against single alphanumeric tokens of the Aurion label, so a class such as MPI-K1 never matches and collesGroup is silently null
pinned.action: normalise the roster class with the same tokenizer as the label, then re-baseline: the group must resolve

pinned.test: people: the colles roster is re-read from Supabase on every search, unlike /colles/group
pinned.reason: withCollesGroups (palantir/route.ts) selects the whole colles_students table on every /palantir/people request and swallows errors, bypassing the 6 h rosterRows cache
pinned.action: reuse rosterRows(), then re-baseline: one read per TTL

pinned.test: a permanent 401 from the publish sink is retried six times before the daemon gives up
pinned.reason: publish() retries any failure, including permanent 4xx, six times with 30 min sleeps, burning about 2.5 h of the 4 h unit timeout
pinned.action: fail fast on 4xx other than 408/429, then re-baseline: one attempt

pinned.test: an unescaped ]]> inside a CDATA payload truncates the update silently (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: page-parser.ts reads a CDATA payload up to the next ]]> and silently truncates the update at an unescaped marker instead of failing loudly
pinned.action: refuse an unescaped ]]> inside a CDATA payload, then re-baseline: the update must be rejected rather than truncated

pinned.test: a label whose zero-width space sits between two words becomes unmatchable (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: page-parser.ts strips the zero-width space of a menu label without turning it into a word boundary, so the label becomes unmatchable and the flow answers "MenuId non trouvé" (500)
pinned.action: replace the zero-width space with a space before normalising the label, then re-baseline: the label must match

pinned.test: a truncated grades table with no rendered row is answered as empty (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: page-parser.ts assertComplete skips the truncation check when no row was parsed ("if (parsed && ...)"), so a table announcing 5 rows and rendering none is answered as an empty list and cached 30 min by the route
pinned.action: run the truncation guard even when no row was parsed, then re-baseline: the table must be refused as truncated

pinned.test: a nested table inside a grades cell shifts every following value one column (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: page-parser.ts truncates a grades cell at the inner of a nested table, so every following value shifts one column
pinned.action: parse the cell with nested-tag awareness, then re-baseline: every value must stay in its own column

pinned.test: a grades row missing its leading cells maps values into the wrong columns (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: page-parser.ts parseGrades has no shape guard (unlike parseChoiceRows), so a row missing its leading cells maps a grade into the code column and a code into the date column
pinned.action: require the same non-empty column shape as parseChoiceRows, then re-baseline: the row must be refused

pinned.test: an absences date cell with any other style is dropped and shifts every value one column (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: page-parser.ts only recognises the absence date cell as exactly a gridcell with style text-align: left, so any other style (trailing semicolon, extra attribute) loses the date and shifts every value one column
pinned.action: match the date cell on its role with a tolerant pattern, then re-baseline: the date must be read

pinned.test: two date-shaped absence cells leave the date empty and shift every value one column (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: page-parser.ts keeps neither date when an absences row carries two date-shaped cells, leaving the date empty and shifting every value one column
pinned.action: keep the first date-shaped cell and skip the extra one, then re-baseline: the date must be read and the columns stay aligned

pinned.test: the planning POST advertises the server's current UTC offset, not the requested window's (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: planning.ts (same pattern in palantir.ts) advertises the server's current UTC offset instead of the offset of the requested window, so a window in the other DST regime is sent an hour off
pinned.action: derive the offset from the requested window's date, then re-baseline: the advertised offset must match the window

pinned.test: an unknown route answers the not-found body while a malformed URL bypasses that handler (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: index.ts leaves FST_ERR_BAD_URL out of FRAMEWORK_MESSAGES and the router replies before the handler, so a malformed URL (GET /%2) is answered with fastify's raw router message instead of the sanitised {statusCode, code, error, message} contract
pinned.action: map FST_ERR_BAD_URL in the framework handler, then re-baseline: the malformed URL must answer the sanitised body

pinned.test: a consulter row whose detail renders no datagrid is dropped while its category stays (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: documents.ts drops a consulter row whose detail page renders no datagrid, while its category is still reported as a normal (ok) leaf with 0 documents
pinned.action: report the missing datagrid on the leaf, then re-baseline: the category must carry the error instead of looking normal

pinned.test: a datagrid download answered with a redirect fails instead of following it (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: documents.ts rejects a download POST answered with a 302 ("Échec du téléchargement (HTTP 302)") instead of following the Location, while the consulter path does follow redirects
pinned.action: follow the redirect like the consulter path, then re-baseline: the download must succeed

pinned.test: a leaf page answered with a 302 is reported as a ViewState error and drops its category (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: documents.ts does not follow a 302 leaf response and session-manager.ts parses its empty body as a ViewState, so the leaf errors with "ViewState non trouvé" and its whole category disappears
pinned.action: follow the leaf redirect, then re-baseline: the leaf must be walked instead of dropped

pinned.test: bytes beyond the declared content-length are ignored, so a short PDF answers 500 (pinned)
pinned.reason: menu.ts's declared-length guard is unreachable with undici (a short body raises a TypeError caught outside, extra bytes are dropped), so a mis-declared length surfaces as 500 "Réponse amont illisible" instead of 502
pinned.action: map a declared-length mismatch to the 502 branch, then re-baseline: a short PDF must answer 502

pinned.test: a failed PDF fetch answers 502 without reading the error body, leaving its response unfinished (pinned)
pinned.reason: menu.ts returns null on !res.ok without reading or cancelling the error body, so the upstream socket and its buffered body stay pinned until GC
pinned.action: cancel the error body before returning null, then re-baseline: the failed response must be drained

pinned.test: frLongDate reads 03/04/2026 as 3 April, never as 4 March (pinned ambiguity)
pinned.reason: menu-date.ts always reads the d/m/y path day-first and only swaps when the second slot exceeds 12, so 03/04/2026 is fixed as 3 April and the other reading is unreachable
pinned.action: make the day-first reading explicit (a documented rule or an explicit format), then re-baseline: the same label must still read 3 April, never 4 March

pinned.test: frLongDate accepts day 45 and 31 February on the month-name path (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: menu-date.ts returns day Number(m[1]) from the month-name branch without cal(), so 45 janvier 2026 gives day 45 and 31 février 2026 gives 31 February
pinned.action: reject day > daysIn(month, year) on the month-name path, then re-baseline: the impossible date must be refused

pinned.test: frLongDate accepts 31 November and 30 February through cal (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: menu-date.ts cal() only bounds the day to 1..31 and the month to 1..12, so 31/11/2026 and 2026-02-30 pass the numeric paths
pinned.action: bound the day by the month's real length in cal(), then re-baseline: both labels must be refused

pinned.test: frLongDate cannot read the French ordinal 1er, so a 1st-of-month menu date reads as stale (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: menu-date.ts's regex cannot read the ordinal (the suffix er breaks the day-then-month pattern), so a 1st-of-month label returns null and the menu is reported stale after every TTL, costing one page probe
pinned.action: allow an optional er suffix, then re-baseline: the ordinal label must be read

pinned.test: GET /crous/888/menu serves a 1917 date when the published date is ISO (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: castelru.ts formats an ISO published date by splitting on "-" and reading [d, m, y], so "2026-09-11" is served as dimanche 18 mars 1917
pinned.action: parse the date through frLongDate before formatting, then re-baseline: the ISO date must be served as 11 septembre 2026

pinned.test: GET /crous/887/menu answers 500 Erreur base de données for a slashed published date (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: castelru.ts feeds a slashed date into the date formatter, Intl.DateTimeFormat.format throws RangeError, and toDailyMenu calls it outside any try, so the whole route answers 500 "Erreur base de données"
pinned.action: return an empty date when the parts are not finite, then re-baseline: the route must answer 200 with an empty date

pinned.test: POST /print/jobs/upload answers 400 Fichier manquant when a filename* decodes to CR/LF (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: jobs-upload/route.ts only sees request.file() and @fastify/busboy drops the part whose decoded filename* contains CR/LF, so the caller sees 400 "Fichier manquant" as if no file had been sent
pinned.action: distinguish an unusable file part from a missing one and answer 400 "Nom de fichier invalide", then re-baseline: the status must be 400 with an explicit filename message

pinned.test: POST /print/jobs/upload re-logs in once after a lost session and answers 500 with Retry-After 5 (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: print.ts marks the failure not retryable once the upload body has been streamed, so a lost SafeQ session answers 500 "Erreur amont" and the file body is never re-sent
pinned.action: answer 502/503 with Retry-After and a distinct message stating the file can be re-sent, then re-baseline: the status must be 502

pinned.test: POST /print/jobs answers 500 Erreur amont with Retry-After 5 when a SafeQ block has no job id or no separator (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: print.ts throws "Bloc d'impression sans identifiant" for a job block without a data-job-id and "Aperçu d'impression inattendu" for an overview without a separator, and the route maps both to 500 "Erreur amont"
pinned.action: answer 502 for a drifted page instead of 500, then re-baseline: the status must be 502

pinned.test: POST /print/jobs only delimits the attribute-free job div, so an attributed page falls back to the data-job-id marks (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: print.ts delimits blocks with the literal attribute-free job div, so a real attributed page takes the data-job-id fallback and every mark becomes a row (here an empty phantom row id 9 next to the real job)
pinned.action: match the block opening with a regex that accepts attributes, then re-baseline: only the real job must be listed

pinned.test: POST /print/balance reports a dot-thousands amount as 0, keeps a negative amount and reads empty spans as 0 (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: print.ts parseAmount rejects any 1-3 digit dot-group amount to avoid a thousands separator, which also swallows a legitimate three-decimal amount, and a missing or empty span is read as 0
pinned.action: decide the separator from the whole string instead of a fixed 3-digit rule, then re-baseline: the dot-group amount must be read instead of 0

pinned.test: GET /updates ranks a row without a version first, sorted as the string "undefined" (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: updates.ts sorts with compareVersionsDesc(String(a.version), String(b.version)), so a missing version becomes the string "undefined", whose NaN comparison falls into localeCompare and sorts above every digit
pinned.action: sort rows without a finite version to the end (date descending as a tie-break), then re-baseline: the version-less row must be last

pinned.test: GET /updates answers 500 Erreur base de données when PostgREST returns HTML with a 200 (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: supabase.ts rethrows an unparseable body with status 200 attached, so sentry.ts respondDbError sees a non-upstream error and answers 500 "Erreur base de données" instead of "Réponse amont illisible"
pinned.action: detect a non-JSON body (or carry the parse flag) in respondDbError and answer 502 "Réponse amont illisible" with Retry-After 5, then re-baseline: the status must be 502

pinned.test: GET /updates answers 500 Erreur base de données for an upstream 429 with no Retry-After (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: sentry.ts sets isUpstream only for status >= 500, so a PostgREST 429 (or 408) is answered 500 "Erreur base de données" and the Retry-After: 5 header is skipped
pinned.action: treat a non-query upstream status (at minimum 408/429) as upstream, then re-baseline: a 429 must answer 502 with Retry-After 5

pinned.test: GET /updates answers 200 with an empty list for a PostgREST 200 with an empty body and caches it for 24 h (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: supabase.ts maps an empty body to an empty array and putCache stores it with the 24 h updates TTL, so /updates is frozen as an empty list for a day even after the upstream recovers
pinned.action: treat an empty body (or a non-array data) as a fetch failure, then re-baseline: the empty generation must not be cached and the next call must refetch

pinned.test: GET /crous/888/menu reads an ISO published date as DD-MM-YYYY and serves a 1917 date (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: castelru.ts formatMenuDate splits the published date on "-" and reads [d, m, y], so the ISO "2026-09-11" is formatted as 18 mars 1917 while menuDayCurrent reads the same row as a past day
pinned.action: build the date through the shared frLongDate parser, then re-baseline: the ISO date must be served as 11 septembre 2026

pinned.test: GET /crous/887/menu rejects on a slashed date and the numbered route answers 500 Erreur base de données (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: castelru.ts passes a slashed date to the date formatter, Intl throws RangeError: Invalid time value, and toDailyMenu calls it outside any try, so the route answers 500 "Erreur base de données"
pinned.action: return the raw label or an empty date when the parts are not finite, then re-baseline: the route must answer 200

pinned.test: GET /findmyroom/rooms leaves expired rooms available when the upstream clock is unreadable (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: findmyroom.ts markClosedRooms returns the payload untouched when the upstream heure cannot be parsed, so rooms past their libre_jusqua stay DISPONIBLE and the building counts stay optimistic
pinned.action: fall back to the Paris wall clock when heure is unreadable, then re-baseline: the expired rooms must be marked FERMEE

pinned.test: GET /findmyroom/rooms throws a TypeError when the upstream room list is missing (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: findmyroom.ts maps rooms.salles without validating it, so a 200 body without salles throws a TypeError that respondFindmyroomError reports as 500 "Erreur base de données" instead of 502
pinned.action: validate that salles is an array and throw an error carrying status 502, then re-baseline: the response must be 502 with Retry-After 5

pinned.test: GET /findmyroom/buildings answers NaN counts for a building row without dispo (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: findmyroom.ts computes Math.max(0, b.dispo - closed) and turns an undefined or string dispo into NaN, which fails the whole /findmyroom/buildings response at serialization time
pinned.action: default the row inputs with Number(b.dispo) || 0 before computing, then re-baseline: the row must be served with a finite count

pinned.test: GET /badjunia/status answers an all-null status when one service carries no lastCheck (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: badjunia/route.ts read() throws "statut badjunia illisible" when a service's lastCheck.up is not a boolean, and the handler's catch turns the whole payload into the all-null UNKNOWN status with X-BadJunia-Verified false
pinned.action: treat a missing lastCheck as unknown for that service only, then re-baseline: the sibling services' status must survive

pinned.test: GET /aurion/documents/file serves a token issued for another account to any caller (pinned defect)
pinned.reason: documents/route.ts maps a token to the buffered bytes and serves them on redemption without binding the token to the requesting account, so any caller holding the one-shot 60 s token receives the document
pinned.action: seal the requesting account (or warm key) into the token and require the same session on redemption, then re-baseline: a stranger must be refused

pinned.test: a token sealed for one flow opens under another flow with its jar and home, only the nav is dropped (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts openSession returns the same jar and home when the sealed flow differs and only drops nav, so the flow label cannot be used as a security boundary
pinned.action: include the flow in the AAD (or drop the flow check and document the token as endpoint-agnostic), then re-baseline: a token sealed for another flow must not open

pinned.test: three concurrent wrong-password logins for one key collapse into one upstream attempt and one strike (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts single-flights concurrent logins for one credential key, so 3 client attempts become 1 upstream attempt and 1 strike and the brake counts upstream attempts, not client attempts
pinned.action: count client attempts (or keep the collapse and document it in the refusal contract), then re-baseline: three client attempts must be visible to the brake

pinned.test: the refusal brake is keyed on the email and password pair, so varying the password is never braked (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts keys the strike counter on the salted email+password warm key, so every distinct password restarts the counter at 0 and guessing passwords for one known address is never throttled
pinned.action: key the brake on the salted email (or email + client IP), then re-baseline: the 4th wrong password for one email must be refused without an upstream login

pinned.test: a preheat started before revokeSessions is still joined by a post-revoke caller (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts builds the preheat flight key from credentialKey and flow without the revocation epoch, so a post-revoke caller joins the pre-revoke walk and inherits its navigation state
pinned.action: include epoch in the preheat flight key, then re-baseline: a post-revoke caller must start a new walk

pinned.test: revokeSessions clears sessions and the menu registry but keeps flow entries and menu bodies (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts revokeSessions clears sessions, menuRegistry, refusals and eraRefusals but not flowEntries or menuBodies, so a post-revoke caller can be served a pre-revoke viewState or formId
pinned.action: clear flowEntries and menuBodies in revokeSessions, then re-baseline: neither store must answer after a revoke

pinned.test: dropCache during flight discards the in-flight result and lets a second loader run (pinned)
pinned.reason: supabase.ts dropCache deletes the inFlight entry too, so the running loader drops its value un-stored and a second caller starts a second upstream load for the same key
pinned.action: leave the in-flight promise registered until it settles and use a dropped flag to decide storage, then re-baseline: the concurrent caller must join the same load

pinned.test: the cache entry keeps the first caller's TTL, a later caller's longer TTL is ignored (pinned)
pinned.reason: supabase.ts answers a live entry with HIT and the entry's own expiry, so the TTL of a key belongs to the first writer and a later caller's longer TTL is silently ignored
pinned.action: re-stamp (or refuse) a hit whose requested ttlMs differs from the stored entry's, then re-baseline: the longer TTL must be honoured

pinned.test: eviction is scoped to the family before the first colon, so a print write evicts another account's print entry (pinned)
pinned.reason: supabase.ts familyOf splits on the first colon, so print:jobs:* and print:balance:* are one family and a full cache evicts the oldest member of the incoming family even when an older unrelated entry is present
pinned.action: derive the family from the route namespace (the first two segments), then re-baseline: a balance write must not evict a jobs entry

pinned.test: the menu registry is credential-free: a label learned from one account's render repoints it for every account (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts learnMenuIds writes label to menuid into one process-wide map with no credential or deployment in the key, so one account's render repoints the sidebar for every other account for 30 min
pinned.action: namespace the registry key by the upstream deployment (or warm key), then re-baseline: another account's render must not change the label

pinned.test: one account's render clears the era refusal of every flow for every account (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts learnMenuIds calls eraRefusals.m.clear(), so one account's successful render wipes every flow's era flag for all accounts and re-arms flows known broken
pinned.action: clear only the flags the render proves (per flow, not clear()), then re-baseline: the other flows' flags must survive

pinned.test: one account's reduced-menu refusal blocks the flow for every other account (pinned)
pinned.reason: session-manager.ts keys eraRefusals by flow name only, so one account's reduced-menu error disables the flow for every account for 10 minutes with no upstream retry
pinned.action: scope the era flag to the deployment, then re-baseline: another account must still be allowed the flow

pinned.test: an unserializable payload is cached at its walked size and served as a hit (pinned)
pinned.reason: supabase.ts sizeOf walks the value and never serializes it, so a value whose toJSON throws is stored at its walked size and served as a HIT; a circular object would overflow the stack in sizeOf
pinned.action: validate the payload before putCache (routes only store parsed JSON), then re-baseline: the payload must not be cached

closed: tests/security/probes-growth.test.cjs — stores de session sans plafond : bounded() prend un max (2000, 10000 pour le registre de menus) et évince le moins récemment utilisé, assertion re-baselinée sur le plafond

tests/logic/dead-code.test.mjs — STATIC_TTL_MS (TTL fantôme 12 h) : constante supprimée, assertion re-baselinée à 0 occurrence
tests/logic/dead-code.test.mjs — census d'exports : 27 des 32 valeurs non consommées dans src/ ont perdu `export` ; 5 restent exportées car tests/ les importe

tests/logic/print-client.test.mjs — listJobs : overview sans séparateur → toute la chaîne dans date, owner vide (figé) : correctif appliqué (erreur nommée au lieu d une perte/du 0 muet), assertions re-baselinées dans le même commit
